CustomObject.description: Adobe Acrobat Sign REST credentials for the Order Form signed write-back (signer-typed PO). Values are entered in the org, never in the repo. Blank key = PO form-data write-back is skipped silently. Visibility is Public because production deploys reject Protected (Protected is only meaningful in managed packages); the org's restrict-custom-settings default keeps non-admins from reading it.
CustomObject.label: Order Form Adobe Settings
